LESSON: ULUM AL- HADITH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al- Hadith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Ulum al- Hadith. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
4. explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim
5. practise the teachings of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in daily life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
   In simple words: practise until you can apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

4. explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

5. practise the teachings of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in daily life
   In simple words: practise until you can practise the teachings of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in daily life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Ulum al- Hadith using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Ulum al- Hadith in the examples.
2. Explain Ulum al- Hadith to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ulum al- Hadith.
4. Show that you can: describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ulum al- Hadith using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Ulum al- Hadith important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs in groups and write notes,
2. Communication and collaboration: listening and teamwork skills enhanced as learners discuss the development of Hadith during the Prophet (S.A.W.) and Rightly Guided Caliphs’ time in groups.
3. Self-efficacy: Effective communication skills enhanced as learners role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith.
4. Discuss the relevance of the selected Hadith in the life of a Muslim and make notes,
5. Self-efficacy: Self-awareness skill is enhanced as learners role-play respect for authority within and outside the school.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith?
2. Why is it important for a Muslim to learn Ulum al- Hadith?
3. Why is intention important in Islam?
4. Why should Muslims respect authority?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
4. explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
